name: The Westin Copley Place
insider_take: Located in Boston's prestigious Back Bay, this towering hotel sits directly above Copley Place mall and connects to the Prudential Center via skybridge - making it a shopping paradise even in harsh New England winters.
whats_special: The Westin Copley Place boasts one of Boston's most iconic locations, standing 36 floors tall with breathtaking views of the Charles River and city skyline. It's the only hotel in Boston directly connected to two major shopping centers, and sits just steps from the historic Trinity Church and the Boston Public Library's stunning McKim Building - often called a "palace for the people."
pro_tip: Request a room on floors 20+ facing northeast for unobstructed views of the Charles River and Cambridge skyline - these rooms offer some of the best urban vistas in all of Boston.
dont_miss: Walk just two blocks to Copley Square to see the architectural marvel where H.H. Richardson's Trinity Church (1877) faces off against the Italian Renaissance grandeur of the Boston Public Library. The square also hosts the Boston Marathon finish line - one of America's most famous sporting landmarks.
pros: Prime Back Bay location connected to Copley Place shopping mall
Signature Heavenly Beds for exceptional sleep comfort
WestinWORKOUT fitness studio with state-of-the-art equipment
Multiple dining options including Bar 10 and fine dining restaurant
cons: Large convention hotel with busy lobby atmosphere
Premium pricing typical of luxury downtown Boston hotels
